one_line_request: Enhance the platform's visual design/UI quality
open_questions: No business-context/ file exists for this initiative; BRD grounded in code/QA evidence instead.
No confirmed business owner or committed success-metric threshold — proposed metrics need stakeholder sign-off.
Mantine 9 vs Tailwind consolidation is an unresolved structural decision, out of scope for this PRD/FRD.
No budget/timeline specified anywhere in available documentation.

acceptance_criteria.text: WHEN a user with dark mode enabled loads any of the 64 pages lacking dark: variants, the system SHALL render all surfaces/text/borders using DESIGN.md dark-* tokens.
IF a page introduces a new bg-/text-/border- Tailwind class, THEN the system SHALL require a matching dark: variant before merge.
WHEN dark-mode coverage is re-measured, the system SHALL report 286/286 pages with at least one dark: variant.
WHEN a form field is rendered, the system SHALL associate it with a label via htmlFor/id or aria-label.
WHEN a modal/dialog/drawer is opened, the system SHALL expose role=dialog, aria-modal=true, and aria-labelledby or aria-label, matching SlidePanel.tsx's contract.
WHEN an img or icon-only button is rendered, the system SHALL provide non-empty alt or aria-label.
IF a new dialog/input/icon-only component is added to components/ui/, THEN the system SHALL require the corresponding a11y attributes before acceptance.
WHEN this epic is complete, the system SHALL show issues A11Y-01 through A11Y-04 reported CLOSED.
WHEN text at text-xs or smaller uses --text-muted, the system SHALL guarantee contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 in both light and dark schemes.
WHEN tailwind-presets.ts's table-header preset is fixed, the system SHALL apply it once so all 100+ consuming headers inherit it.
IF a page overrides the shared table-header preset with a non-conformant combination, THEN the system SHALL flag it as a design-system violation.
WHEN a PR modifies frontend/app or frontend/components, the system SHALL check the diff against DESIGN.md Do's/Don'ts and surface a warning on violation.
WHEN a new shared UI primitive is proposed, the system SHALL require reuse of existing design-system.ts tokens over hardcoded values.
IF a proposed component duplicates an existing ui/ primitive's responsibility, THEN the system SHALL require justification or consolidation before addition.
WHEN a table wider than its container renders at <=320px, the system SHALL provide overflow-x-auto with an explicit min-width on the inner table.
WHEN attendance/shift-swap's assignment grid renders at <=320px, the system SHALL apply the same scroll-container treatment used elsewhere.
